function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您參考以下幾個可靠來源：

| 平台 | 特色 | 連結 |
|------|------|------|
| Bloomberg | 提供即時黃金期貨、現貨價格及相關新聞 | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets |
| Reuters | 全球金融資訊，含黃金即時報價 | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities |
| Kitco | 專門的貴金屬行情網站，提供即時現貨與期貨價格 | https://www.kitco.com |
| 美國商品期貨交易所（CME） | 黃金期貨合約價格 | https://www.cmegroup.com |

您也可以在手機金融 App（如 Bloomberg、CNBC、Yahoo Finance 等）快速查看「Gold」或「XAU/USD」的即時價格。祝您投資順利！
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). They want the current price. We don't have real-time data. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or market data. We can provide approximate recent price if known. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites.
